name: Barracuda Cannabis Cups – Peppermint
description: Michigan's #1 chocolate edible just went bite sized. These delicious dark chocolate bite-sized cups are filled with cool, refreshing peppermint. Infused with a potent 200mg THC per pack, these mini treats have some bite! Each cup (8 per pack) contains 25mg THC and fully activates in 1-2 hours.
